name: ElevenLabs
description: Eleven Labs is an AI audio-model company with its European headquarters in London, United Kingdom. Their mission is to enable expressive and high-quality voice and audio generation, bringing natural, human-level text-to-speech and voice-cloning to creators and applications.

sources.notes: ElevenLabs describes its London office as its European headquarters and the centre for worldwide operations; this record therefore uses the scoped wording European headquarters.

verification.notes: Location metadata verified as a regional headquarters; no unsupported claim is made about a sole global headquarters.
